# Astronomical 0.2.56
## New - **Observatory console chat unified with Thin Talk** — the console now shares the same conversation surface and rendering as Thin Talk, with updated console rendering.
## Fixes - **Live MLX memory snapshot during image generation** — memory usage is now correctly reported during image generation steps.
## Runtime - Updated the pinned MLX runtime from v0.32.2 to v0.32.3.
## Compatibility - This release preserves existing user state, configuration, and downloaded models.
## Distribution - macOS 14.0 or later, Apple Silicon (arm64). Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple; delivered through the public download and the signed Sparkle update feed.
